summary: FAIL on candidate df8225e5 (source a60a962). The P7 product behaviour I exercised is sound: P7 integration suites 144/144, EN/AR P7 screens 14/14 with axe, a clean build, all six historical validators and the pipeline PASS, and all handover checks PASS. Configuration transfer and data migration preserve integrity, with authorization, If-Match and audit on every mutation. About and the in-app register show the build's 412-row register honestly, with Unknown never shown as zero, and EN/AR source fidelity to the playbook holds. Two new findings. F-DG7-913 (Medium, mandatory, REQ-S02-005): the register row REQ-S16-024 labels the unbuilt 'Administration > Retention' screens as delivered, and neither the known limitations nor the release notes disclose it. F-DG7-914 (Low, REQ-S17-004): the connector handover carries stale 'not yet written' and 'to be confirmed' text. In addition, REQ-DLV-008/-011/-012/-024/-030 are literally unmet by DG7's own protocol hits (C2, C3, C5, A27 K11). They are accurately disclosed as release blockers under D-270, the release-auditor decides whether they block, and I do not count them as met. Gate-time clauses are named honestly and remain for the gate and the seal.
